name: @schramm2/spyglass
description: Verify code changes with real tools and keep the evidence, for coding agents and the people who review their work.
author: Matthew Schramm

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/*.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --external:./browser-proxy.js --outdir=dist --entry-names='[name]' --chunk-names='chunks/[name]-[hash]' && esbuild src/browser.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:./browser-proxy.js --external:./state.js --external:./errors.js --outfile=dist/browser.js && node dist/export-schemas.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests fixtures examples landing
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests fixtures examples landing
